purpose: Evaluate two preregistered, outcome-blind FaaSRank-singleton/Hiku-repeated-demand routers on the fresh E41-E45 low-load development cohort. V25 put the fixed FaaSRank-singleton router first in QPR but third in throughput, 1.52% behind Hiku. All nine baselines and both candidates are completed before any performance result is read.

fresh_development_cohort.reason: E41-E45 were declared only as unused reserve seeds in the V25 full source and have never been captured, referenced, executed, or inspected. E21-E40 are closed to further tuning; E04-E10 remain unused; E11-E20 remain sealed confirmation seeds.

source.high_profile_note: The global frozen high profile remains 7k; V26 itself runs low only.

diagnostic_basis.reason_for_family: V25c already wins QPR and nearly matches Hiku throughput. V26 preserves its frozen FaaSRank singleton rule and replaces only the repeated-demand LoadLeast expert with either the exact legacy Hiku proxy or the existing load-faithful Hiku proxy. No fitted mixing coefficient or post-result threshold is introduced.

candidates.definition: Order functions by current-window demand. Use the frozen deterministic FaaSRank score at demand one; at repeated demand use the existing load-faithful Hiku proxy based on pending-plus-running work and its pre-window idle-container token.
Order functions by current-window demand. Use the frozen deterministic FaaSRank score at demand one; at repeated demand use the exact existing legacy resident-only Hiku proxy.

development_matrix.result_blind_execution_order: Commit this plan before expanding E41-E50. Capture E41-E45 only after the plan commit. Build references serially. Complete and QC all baseline and candidate runs serially before calculating any throughput, latency, cost, QPR, ranking, or candidate comparison.

eligibility_per_candidate: all five reference builds and candidate runs pass QC and result-blind pairing
all 45 baseline runs pass QC and result-blind pairing
mean fixed-window throughput is strictly greater than every one of the nine baseline means on E41-E45
mean QPR is strictly greater than every one of the nine baseline means on E41-E45
frozen V8 middle/high E01-E03 retain first-place throughput and QPR
selection_rule: Run both candidates completely. Among candidates passing every gate, freeze the first in fixed priority v26a then v26b. Ties with a baseline do not pass. If neither passes, select none, close E41-E45 permanently, do not subdivide or retune this family on those seeds, and keep confirmation sealed.

confirmation.closure_requirement: For every load, optimized NSESche must rank first in mean fixed-window throughput and QPR against frozen E11-E20 baselines; otherwise report not closed without seed deletion or confirmation-set tuning.
